Method of Attack: Malicious redirect via cloaking technique in Google Alerts leading to malware installation
Installs malware that launches a headless Chromium browser performing suspicious activity and high CPU usage
Indicators of Compromise: Redirect from Google Alert URL to malicious download site
Impacted Systems: Users receiving Google Alerts and visiting malicious URLs
Attack Vector: Google Alerts links with cloaked URLs redirecting users to malicious sites
